name: Black Claw Stout
summary: Beneath Stormwind, Zardeth of the Black Claw prepares a drink for Lord Wishock. The stout is delivered as an ordinary tavern beverage.

sections.title: A Toxic Draught
sections.body: Zardeth of the Black Claw works beneath the notice of Stormwind's city guard, in the operation below the Slaughtered Lamb's taprooms. Lord Wishock repeatedly threatens to shut it down, though he runs up unpaid bar tabs upstairs. Zardeth decides to settle the score with the noble's weakness for strong drink. He disguises a lethal dose in a common tavern refreshment.

sections.title: Quiet Assassination
sections.body: Lord Wishock receives the stout in Stormwind Keep's Hall of Petitioners. His pompous arrogance and thirst leave him eager to accept what he mistakes for a servant's attentive offering. The noble downs the brew on the spot. Its poison acts almost instantly, silencing one of the cult's most persistent political critics under the Royal Court's very noses.

faq.answer: Zardeth of the Black Claw concocts Black Claw Stout in the catacombs beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter for Lord Wishock.

faq.q: Who is the target of the stout?
aliases: who dies from black claw stout
faq.answer: Lord Wishock is the target, a high-handed noble in the Hall of Petitioners who campaigns to shut down the warlock haven while drinking there on credit.
Zardeth of the Black Claw brews the stout in the crypts beneath the Slaughtered Lamb.

faq.q: Why is Lord Wishock offered the stout?
faq.answer: Zardeth sends Lord Wishock the stout in the Hall of Petitioners, asking the courier to see how the noble likes his special brew.

angles.text: For Stormwind's hidden warlock coven, the brew is an errand. A meddling noble wants its haven beneath the Slaughtered Lamb shut down.
Carrying the brew into Stormwind Keep brings the warlocks operating beneath the Slaughtered Lamb close to the capital's nobles.
